result.note: A one-off diplomatic incident with little durable content. One recall question tests where the collision took place.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India summoned Pakistan's Charge d'Affaires in New Delhi after a Pakistan Navy vessel collided with an Indian Navy ship on a routine surveillance mission. Where did the collision take place?
questions.explain: The collision happened in the Arabian Sea on 15 September 2026, during a routine Indian Navy surveillance mission. The Ministry of External Affairs called the Pakistani vessel's conduct unacceptable and unprofessional, saying it was manoeuvring at high speed. No major damage was reported.
questions.source: a Pakistan Navy vessel collided with an Indian Navy ship during a routine surveillance mission in the Arabian Sea on Tuesday, September 15.
